items.title: 68429_Walter P. Thomas oral history interview
items.q: I taught him. I only gave him a few lessons... His name was Wyler.

ctx.x: Can you remember any other guys?

Well, I can tell you some of the stars I gave lessons to. The one guy who played.... I can't think of his name now. He played with this singing group, them brothers... They were brothers who had a band, and he was the alto player, and I taught him. I only gave him a few lessons, because he was in town with Les Brown's band. Doris Day's first husband. His name was Wyler. He had studied with Merle, and when he came to New York with the band, he studied...
